protected_task.root_cause: Starting best at 0 violates the stated invariant for an all-negative list, so the second test incorrectly returns 0.
protected_task.decisive_resolution: Initializing best from values[0] makes the invariant true before iteration; the tests return 7, -2, and 6.
protected_task.acceptance_note: Accept any implementation or precise pseudocode that satisfies the specification and all checks for greedy and dynamic programming strategies; do not require textual agreement with this reference.

fresh_mastery_check.root_cause: The loop replaces total with the current label length instead of accumulating the current length with prior lengths.
fresh_mastery_check.decisive_resolution: Update total with total + label.length on each iteration.
fresh_mastery_check.accepted_invariant: After each iteration, total equals the sum of the lengths of exactly the prefix already examined.

remediation_plan: Reteaching for greedy and dynamic programming strategies follows the signal actually observed, not a fixed script. If the signal is "prerequisite gap": Return to the smallest prerequisite needed for greedy and dynamic programming strategies, model it in a concrete or text-only representation, then retry one fresh item. If the signal is "procedure without understanding": Ask the learner to explain or represent why the approach to greedy and dynamic programming strategies works before continuing. If the signal is "correct but low confidence": Confirm the reasoning specifically, offer one varied example of greedy and dynamic programming strategies, and avoid unnecessary remediation. If the signal is "repeated error pattern": Name the observable pattern neutrally, contrast it with a worked example, and schedule a short same-day or next-session review. If the signal is "requests the answer to graded work": Explain the concept, ask a diagnostic question, or help isolate the defect. Do not supply the graded artifact, solution code, or finished creative work. If the signal is "mastery evidence": Require accurate independent application plus explanation on a later or different occasion before marking greedy and dynamic programming strategies mastered. Re-check with one fresh item of the same kind before moving on, and record which signal was seen so the pattern is visible across the unit rather than treated as a one-off.
extension_plan: Apply greedy and dynamic programming strategies under a new constraint, compare two approaches or perspectives, or explain the idea to someone else using an original example.
